description: Teaching contract documentation, not executable JSON Schema.
raw: UCI dteday/cnt or synthetic date/requests. Unique ascending consecutive YYYY-MM-DD dates; integer counts 0..1,000,000,000; at least 42 days.

features.prior_day_requests: Count on target minus one day; available at origin end-of-day.
features.prior_week_requests: Count on target minus seven days; available before origin.

target: Next calendar day's total count, unknown at forecast origin.
split: Earliest examples train; next holdout_days validate; last holdout_days are final test. No shuffle; at least 7 training rows and 7 days per holdout.
protocol: Fixed trained parameters with rolling one-day-ahead origins. Past holdout observations may become legitimate features at later origins. No fitting or selection uses final targets.
inference: Feature-only file with origin/target one day apart. Predictions remain real-valued without implicit clipping/rounding.
